key_terms.الْمَدْحُوَّاتِ: The praiseworthy things/surfaces (referring to the earth)
key_terms.الْمَسْمُوكَاتِ: The elevated things (referring to the skies)

ai.seo_question: What are the divine attributes mentioned in the supplication for Muhammad (peace be upon him) in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This supplication, attributed to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha, employs cosmological imagery to affirm Allah’s sovereignty over creation and His role in shaping human nature (fitrah). It reflects the Shia theological emphasis on divine determination of innate disposition, linking the physical structure of the universe with the spiritual orientation of the heart.
